subject.title: Ollama local provider: native tool_calls not recognized, falls back to unreliable JSON-text parsing

question: Should this be investigated as a current native Ollama tool-call bug, closed later as an unsupported `/v1` configuration case, or consolidated after proof with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101445?
rationale: Current source and the shipped release already support native `tool_calls`, but the issue's live logs and the newer overlapping report are strong enough that automation should not close or patch without exact request/response proof.

options.title: Capture exact Ollama proof first
options.body: Recommended: inspect the reporter's active `models.providers.ollama` api/baseUrl plus raw OpenClaw request and NDJSON response before deciding the repair or closure path.

options.title: Close later as config issue
options.body: If the active route is `openai-completions` against `/v1`, close with the documented native `baseUrl` guidance and do not add a text-to-tool fallback.

options.title: Consolidate with native failure
options.body: If the raw response proves native `/api/chat` `tool_calls` are lost inside OpenClaw, fold the investigation into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101445 or link both under one fix.

recommendation.title: Capture exact Ollama proof first
recommendation.body: Recommended: inspect the reporter's active `models.providers.ollama` api/baseUrl plus raw OpenClaw request and NDJSON response before deciding the repair or closure path.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the native Ollama provider work and authored follow-up hardening, making them the best history-backed owner for the proof/closure decision.
